tickets.title: The published-audience list: one document in the tenant's configuration publication, read through the action's own pin, never re-read on a timer (**amendment 13, E30, 2026-10-28**)

authority.locator: E30 · section 2 of amendment 13, "Done when" (inserted from _evidence/parity-step3/S52/E30.draft.md; the cause R-P607, the root-cause design _evidence/parity-step3/S52/analyst-audience/DESIGN.md; in force under the owner's direction, R-P545)
authority.requirement: the tenant's published audiences are one document, an optional member of its configuration publication, written by every publish, archive, rename, pin and seed as one set publication, and read by every qualification on both hosts through the pin the action already holds: no audience read while the publication is unchanged and the isolate holds it, one storage read after a change or on a new isolate, at any number of audiences; a write is seen on the next action everywhere, with no timer and no KV propagation window; no write is lost to a concurrent one; a document past 2 MiB is refused by name; an unreadable publication fails qualification and never falls back; existing tenants are moved from their KV records by their first audience write and by the five-minute scheduled run, every page of the list read, and until moved their records are read in one wave; the demo's regeneration is one publication; P61.LO3 passes with the copy's old ten-second line crossed between its rounds.

tickets.outcome: A visitor's action on either host never waits on the tenant's audience list growing: with 10 or 3,000 published audiences it reads none while nothing changed and one document when something did, an operator's change qualifies on the very next action everywhere, and no published audience is ever silently dropped.

criteria.observable: On both hosts, at 10, 50, 200 and 1,000 published audiences, under the AA2 lever (500 ms on every remote call, src/units/_parity8.ts remoteLatency), customer profile: an action (a view, a buffered action, the render acknowledgement) whose isolate holds the publication makes no audience read and makes the same own remote calls, in the same waves, as the same action with no audiences (counted, never timed: under the lever equal calls in equal waves are equal latency, and the time is recorded as evidence only; R-P695 (4), R-P696); on an isolate holding nothing it makes exactly one audience read (the member's document) and no KV list or audience get; the reader is every caller of MockSegmentProvider.fetchQualifiedSegments (src/connectors/SegmentProvider.ts:35-36): RealtimeSegmentEngine.ts:716, :1121, :1213, src/reflex/bufferedAction.ts:105, ShopperReflex.ts:815, :1613, :3872. Today listPublished (src/connectors/AudienceStore.ts:75-88) serves its copy only while it is under AUDIENCE_LIST_MS (:25, :76-77) aged from its last re-read (:86), then reads one list (:79) and one get per key awaited in turn (:81-84): REPRODUCED 11, 51, 201 and 1,001 audience calls in as many sequential trips, +5,503 ms at 10 under the lever on both hosts and every action re-reading from 200 up (the re-read outlasting the ten seconds), at 78 ms a call +862 ms, +4,004 ms, 16,042 ms and 79,071 ms (_evidence/parity-step3/S52/analyst-audience/DESIGN.md §2; logs p2-base-l78.log, p2b-base-l500-n10.log).
criteria.proof: The P105 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P105.AL1 in src/units/P105/LEDGER.unit.test.ts and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: Lane E4's guarantee kept and tightened, on both hosts: an audience published, archived, renamed or pinned through this isolate (POST /operator/audiences/publish, src/routes/operator.ts:113-124; rename :441-445; pin :463-467; prune :489-497) qualifies, stops qualifying or reads renamed or pinned on the next action; one committed through another storage handle or binding is seen on the next action that reads the publication head (every operation, src/config/publication.ts:467-469), with no clock moved; nothing reads an audience from KV on the request path once the tenant is moved. Today a write here forgets this isolate's copy (AudienceStore.ts:91-95) and one elsewhere is seen within AUDIENCE_LIST_MS plus KV's own minute (:20-22).
criteria.proof: The P105 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P105.AL2 in src/units/P105/LEDGER.unit.test.ts and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: The writes: each of publish, archive, rename, setPinned and seed is one set publication of the audiences member (publishSet, src/config/publication.ts:938-994, CAS on the head; a conflict retried, bounded), the per-audience KV record written after the commit so get(key) still resolves an archived audience (operator.ts:484-488); two operator writes started together through two stores both survive; the demo's seeding and catalogue regeneration (RealtimeSegmentEngine.ts:337-363, src/reflex/audienceGenerator.ts:182-217) are one publication per pass; a member past 2 MiB is refused 413 document_too_large naming it and nothing changes (publication.ts:7, :100-103; about 3,388 audiences of today's seed size, 619 B each, DESIGN.md §5); a publication that cannot be read fails qualification as an unreadable reflex document does (the session host's action fails; the object host degrades to reflex-only, ShopperReflex.ts:1612-1616) and never falls back to KV. Today a write is one KV put (AudienceStore.ts:97-156) and a list past 1,000 keys is truncated at its first page (:79, cursor never followed): REPRODUCED 995 of 1,000 published returned beside 5 archived, and a 1,001st audience published and never listed (DESIGN.md §2; logs p1-store-base.log, p4-writes-base.log).
criteria.proof: The P105 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P105.AL3 in src/units/P105/LEDGER.unit.test.ts and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: The move, on both hosts: a tenant whose set has no audiences member (the sealed set's own statement, readOptionalPinnedPublication, publication.ts:563-567) is read from its KV records with every page of the list followed and every get issued at once (1,005 keys answer all 1,000 published); its first audience write creates the member from those records in the same publication, and the five-minute scheduled run (src/index.ts:282, running on both profiles :271-273) creates it for every provisioned tenant with no operator; after either, no request path lists KV. The run's reconciliation adopts a KV record into the member only when that record was written after the member's version of that audience, never because it differs: a five-minute run landing between a write's commit and its KV put, or reading a stale KV value, leaves the committed write as it is (R-P696). The run's reconciliation costs, per tenant and per run, only the KV list calls that name its records (one per 1,000 keys) and no get once the move's records are marked, whatever the number of audiences; it reads a record only when the list shows it is not this release's marked write; and every reconciliation call is counted in the run's budget under the invocation's limit (src/learn/hourly.ts RUN_BUDGET), resuming from where it stopped in the next run, never past the limit (R-P699). Today every tenant reads its records with one list and sequential gets (AudienceStore.ts:79-84). The move is metered in the run's budget like the reconciliation and resumes across runs, never past the limit, so the folds keep their budget on every run; a tenant whose audiences cannot fit the member's bound is not moved: its refusal is stored by name with the measured size, it keeps base's KV path for reads and writes so that no answer differs from base's, and the run tries the move again only when its KV records change, never at full cost every run (R-P713). The five-minute run never puts or deletes an audience record: only writes put audience records, each with its content's digest as KV metadata, so no write answered 200 is ever overwritten by the run (R-P725, R-P727). Its steady state is list calls only for every record this release wrote; a record no write of this release has touched (a legacy record, or one an earlier release rewrote) costs at most one metered get per pass of the run's cursor, until this release writes it, because nothing but a read can see an earlier release's write. A write on base's KV path that finds the member created while it wrote carries itself into the member before it answers (compare-and-swap), so it is visible at once (R-P727).
criteria.proof: The P105 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P105.AL4 in src/units/P105/LEDGER.unit.test.ts and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: LOCK, on both hosts: a tenant qualifies only its own audiences (the member scoped by publicationScope, publication.ts:126-136; the store's tenant the route's, src/connectors/index.ts:31, :40); the default tenant's demo surfaces evaluate only their own audiences (SegmentProvider.ts:43-48); qualification answers the same segments as today on the same audiences and contexts; src/reflex/audienceGenerator.test.ts, src/tenancy/storeIsolation.test.ts, src/demos/brighthour/surface.test.ts, src/reflex/shopperReflex.test.ts and src/routes/realtime.sdkContract.test.ts pass (W22.07's qualification fault moved by its R10 to the member's read). Every binding to the tenant's publication that an audience write must not disturb uses the identity over every member but audiences: the render offer and the synthetic monitor's run scope (src/ops/synthetic.ts:106, :221, :579), so an audience write, the move or the reconciliation never fails a synthetic run that base would pass (R-P713).
criteria.proof: The P105 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P105.AL5 in src/units/P105/LEDGER.unit.test.ts and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

Today that control fails on both hosts, the acknowledgement making 53 and 51 own calls where 5 and 3 are expected and taking 26,561 ms (REPRODUCED at a5118d38, DESIGN.md §6, log p3-base-delay.log; R-P603, R-P607); the prototype passes it, 5 and 3 (log p3-proto-delay.log).

criteria.observable: On both hosts, a visitor's personalization read makes no read of shopper overrides: today it lists the override records and reads each one in turn (src/services/RealtimeSegmentEngine.ts:1032 through src/services/FeatureVariableManager.ts), 1 + N sequential calls (measured: 11 calls at 10 overrides, 101 at 100, 1,001 at 1,000; about 0.9 s, 8 s and 79 s at 78 ms a call), while no route writes an override (setUserOverride's callers have no caller) and no answer uses the result (enhancedFeatureVariables is consumed by nothing). The read is removed from the request path; override records that exist are still erased and exported with the visitor's other records as today (src/identity/erase.ts, src/routes/identity.ts) (R-P652; S53/specifier/REPORT-a43d5d7d.md).
criteria.proof: The P105 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P105.AL7 in src/units/P105/LEDGER.unit.test.ts and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: Lane L21 on the pair's next release (the stamps read-only): on a pair tenant the lane may write to, with at least 200 published audiences, an action on each host after more than ten seconds' pause answers within the pair's ordinary action time and its server timing names no audience read; an audience the lane publishes qualifies its visitor on the next action, and one it prunes stops qualifying on the next.
